messages:
Nina (Sales): Quick ask  'Spectra' wants a hosted POC on Fri 2026-09-12 14:00-15:30 UTC. Need scoped API key, IP allowlist, and temporary hosted quota increase to handle ~180 req/min sustained with spikes to 300 req/min. Model requested: redwood-xlarge-v1; avg tokens ~720. No sensitive/customer PII in corpus.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): Which region and endpoint? Streaming? Also need an estimate for total tokens so finance can pre-authorize.

Nina (Sales): Region: eu-west. Endpoint: /v1/chat/completions; streaming enabled. Worst-case token calc: 300 * 720 * 90 = ~19.4M tokens; expected ~4M. They'll be billed after demo.

Talia (Infra): We require org ID, IPs, and confirmation of data handling. We'll create a scoped key with per-route enforcement and automatic expiration. Also recommend disabling embeddings & rerank.

Nina (Sales): Org: org-spectra-502. IPs: 44.55.66.0/24, 3.77.88.99. Expiry: 16:00 UTC (30m buffer). Disable embeddings & rerank.

Maya (Finance): Approve temporary soft quota increase up to projected $1500 usage. Any projection above that triggers manual approval.

Talia (Infra): @ops-rate: create provisional key with soft-quota 200 req/min eq, burst cap 320 req/min for 10min sliding window, per-route block for non-chat endpoints, log-sample 5%, route eu-west.

ops-bot: RW-5130 created: "Spectra POC window - org-spectra-502"  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-5130

ops-bot: Scoped key provisional: sk-sbox-spec-****9cde  expires 2026-09-12T16:00:00Z  per-route allowlist /v1/chat/completions  soft-quota 200 req/min  burst cap 320 req/min (10m)  log-sample 5%.

Arjun (Solutions Eng): I'll send Spectra a guidance note: recommended client backoff + streaming fallback note. Also will setup a small eval prompt set to watch for regression.

Talia (Infra): Fallback: route to redwood-medium-v1 in eu-west if capacity constrained; streaming may convert to non-streaming. Ops will monitor RW-5130 and alert if error rate > 1.5% for 3m.

Nina (Sales): Thanks. I'll update customer and share the key after they sign the data-handling ack.

ops-bot: RW-5130 -> status: scheduled -> monitoring enabled

Nina (Sales): Update: signed ack received, key validated, demo greenlit. :white_check_mark:
